subject: seventeen tools, read first
body:
The MCP server exposes seventeen tools and they are read first: search newsletters, articles, entities and sponsors, then fetch a publication, its articles, its intelligence summary, or an entity page with its mention history. One tool creates an export. Typed ids keep references stable across calls, so an agent carries a publication from search into a profile without a mapping table.

That is the part an action library cares about: an agent resolves a company to a publication set on its own.

Docs are at newsletterfit.com/docs/api and the endpoint is newsletterfit.com/mcp. A trial key is the fastest way to see whether the action set fits.
